preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 150000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of monsters n is between 2 and 300000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**12 and 1 <= b_i <= 10**12 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)] for a_i, b_i in [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)])
preconditions.description: For each monster in each test case, the health a_i and damage b_i are between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]) <= 300000
preconditions.description: The total number of monsters across all test cases does not exceed 300000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(bullets, int) and bullets >= 0 for bullets in [int(output.split()[i]) for i in range(T)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of bullets required to kill all monsters.
